import pandas as pd

orders = pd.read_csv("orders.csv", parse_dates=["order_date"])

in_q4 = (orders["order_date"] >= "2025-10-01") & (orders["order_date"] < "2026-01-01")
q4 = orders[in_q4 & (orders["status"] != "cancelled")]
print(len(q4))

coupon_share = round(q4["coupon_code"].notna().mean(), 3)

marketplace_coupons = ((orders["channel"] == "marketplace") & orders["coupon_code"].notna()).sum()

latest_ids = q4.nlargest(3, "order_date")["order_id"].tolist()
